text.p: --Hambrecht and Quist analyst R. van den Broek said he upgraded Pharmacyclics Inc to a strong buy from a buy.

--"Pharmacyclics' energy-potentiating drugs Gd-Tex and Lu-Tex are entering phase II trials this summer in a variety of cancer indications. In our opinion the growing body of data from these products, albeit early, continues to support their potential as major new modalities for cancer therapy," van den Broek said in a report.

--"Recently the stock has been languishing at its current level with very low volume traded and with very little news. The information flow is expected to increase later this year, and as data from multiple phase II trials on both products begin to emerge early in 1998, we believe that the story will be defined as one of the leading novel drug plays in the sector."
